text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
I'm so relieved that our guests are enjoyin' the hot spring.
It's a bit showy, but they all seem to like that about it.
choice_data_list: I wish we could relax too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな温泉喜んでくれてよかったなぁ。
やたらに派手だけんど、
そこも含めて
楽しんでくれてるみたいだべ。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
At first I wasn't too sure about the way it looked,
but ya can't argue with a performing arts pro.
I guess that's what they call foresight, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの見た目はどうなんだべと思ったけんど、
さすがは芸事の専門家だなぁ。
先見の明、
ってやつだべか。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
From our point of view, the scenery here on the ranch ain't that unusual.
But I guess the city folks rarely ever see places like this.
I bet they'd like it better if my cows were still here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オラたちにとって
牧場の景色はなんてことねぇもんだけど、
街の人たちにとっては
珍しいんだろうな。
牛たちもいれば
もっと楽しんでもらえたんだろうな。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
We all wanna while away the hours in the hot spring, but we can't
afford to yet. Once this is all over, let's all take a dip together.
But ya can't exactly join us, can ya...? W-well, I don't mind if ya do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オラたちも温泉でのんびりしてぇけど、
それはまだ先だべな。
全部終わったら
みんなで温泉に入るべ。
さすがに
あんちゃんも一緒は無理か……
オ、
オラは平気だど？
